findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_ai_stock_analysis" is 2396 chars, far longer than this server's median (474). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_ai_stock_analysis" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_assets_data, get_assets_news, get_latest_news, get_article, get_economic_calendar, get_blogger_sentiment, get_commodity_quote, get_commodity_historical, get_forex_quote, get_all_forex_quotes, get_forex_historical, get_index_quote, get_index_historical, get_crypto_quote, get_all_crypto_quotes, get_crypto_historical, get_crypto_news, get_earnings_call_summary, get_insider_transactions · Private data: get_top_rated_stocks · Public sink: get_article, get_stock_splits, get_buybacks, get_hedge_fund_activity, get_earnings_history, get_hedge_fund_holdings · Destructive: get_ai_stock_analysis, get_options_contract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_assets_data, get_assets_news, get_latest_news, get_article, get_economic_calendar, get_blogger_sentiment, get_commodity_quote, get_commodity_historical, get_forex_quote, get_all_forex_quotes, get_forex_historical, get_index_quote, get_index_historical, get_crypto_quote, get_all_crypto_quotes, get_crypto_historical, get_crypto_news, get_earnings_call_summary, get_insider_transactions · Private data: get_top_rated_stocks · Public sink: get_article, get_stock_splits, get_buybacks, get_hedge_fund_activity, get_earnings_history, get_hedge_fund_holdings · Destructive: get_ai_stock_analysis, get_options_contract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
